topic: a command-line notes tool whose on-disk store is being upgraded to a new format while older files must stay readable, and some notes change or disappear after the upgrade or on a rerun of it
calibration:
Calibration: recent tasks and how often the reference agent solved them (target: 1-3 of 5 runs).
- incremental-aggregate-cache-drift [incremental_state] [hard]: 4/5 -> too_easy (agent median 28.5 steps, reached the faulty files on turn 1). Fix an incremental analytics pipeline whose daily aggregates drift from a full rebuild after source edits, due to cache sign-loss and stale-entry merge bugs.
- event-sourced-ledger-corrections [incremental_state] [hard]: 4/5 -> too_easy (agent median 7.5 steps, reached the faulty files on turn 1). Fix an event-sourced inventory ledger whose incremental stock diverges from a log replay due to bugs in correction and dedup handling.
Tasks solved too often were solved because their fixes could be found by reading and named in a few words. Make this design harder by changing the SHAPE of the problem (behaviour over a sequence that the agent must reason out), not by adding faults, code or steps; make it easier than the too_hard ones.
